subject: Английский язык
authors: Биболетова М. З., Денисенко О. А., Трубанева Н. Н.

chapters.title: 1 Welcome to our school. Section 1. School Life

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 1, с. 6. Послушай запись и скажи, откуда Крис. Догадайся, какой сегодня день.
steps: Chris is from Britain.
Today is the first of September — первый день учебного года.
problems.answer: Крис из Британии; сегодня 1 сентября

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 2, с. 6. Послушай запись, прочитай текст и разыграй диалог по ролям.
steps: Egor: Hi, Sveta! It's nice to see you again. This is Chris. Chris is from Britain.
Sveta: Hello, Chris! Welcome to our school!
Chris: Thank you! I'm glad to be here.
Следим за звуком [ð] в this — язык между зубами.
problems.answer: Диалог знакомства Егора, Светы и Криса — прочитать по ролям

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 3, с. 6. Посмотри на расписание и скажи, во сколько начинается и заканчивается каждый урок.
steps: Maths starts at nine o'clock and finishes at nine forty-five.
Russian starts at nine fifty and finishes at ten thirty-five.
Nature Studies starts at ten forty-five and finishes at eleven thirty.
English starts at eleven forty and finishes at twelve twenty-five.
P.E. starts at twelve thirty-five and finishes at one twenty.
problems.answer: … starts at … and finishes at …

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 4, с. 7. Послушай запись, повтори слова за диктором и прочитай их самостоятельно.
steps: [eɪ] — break, education, nature, information; [ɪ] — history, physical, literature; [ʌ] — subject, Russian, study; [ɜː] — learn, first, Thursday.
Обращаем внимание на ударение: eduCAtion, inforMAtion, LIterature.
problems.answer: Чтение слов по группам звуков

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 5, с. 7. Прочитай таблицу и составь свои предложения с временами из неё.
steps: Present Simple: I listen to music every day.
Past Simple: I read a lot yesterday.
Future Simple: I will study hard tomorrow.
Маркеры: every day / usually — настоящее; yesterday / last week — прошедшее; tomorrow / next year — будущее.
problems.answer: Три предложения — по одному на каждое время

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 6, с. 7. Расскажи, какие уроки у тебя сегодня, какие были вчера и какие будут завтра.
steps: Today I have Russian, English, Maths, Music and P.E.
Yesterday I had Literature, Art, History and Russian.
Tomorrow I will have English, P.E., Maths and Nature Studies.
problems.answer: Today I have …; Yesterday I had …; Tomorrow I will have …

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 7, с. 7. Расскажи Крису, что ты обычно делаешь на уроках.
steps: We count in our Maths lessons.
We draw in our Art lessons.
We read a lot and learn poems by heart in our Literature lessons.
We sing songs in our Music lessons.
We run and play games in our P.E. lessons.
We speak English and learn new words in our English lessons.
problems.answer: We + действие + in our … lessons

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 8, с. 7. Послушай запись, повтори за диктором и прочитай вопросы и ответы с правильной интонацией.
steps: Общие вопросы — восходящая интонация: Will he be in our ↗class? — ↘No, he ↘won't.
Специальные вопросы — нисходящая: Where is she ↘from? — She is from Great ↘Britain.
Did they have good summer ↗holidays? — ↘Yes, they ↘did.
problems.answer: Общие вопросы ↗, специальные и ответы ↘

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 9, с. 7. a) Обсуди школьные предметы, ответив на вопросы. b) Составь вопросы о школьной жизни и задай их одноклассникам.
steps: a) Yes, I will. / No, I won't. Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't. Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. We ran, played football and volleyball, did athletics in P.E.
b) Do you draw in Art lessons? Does he ask a lot of questions? Did you read a lot for Literature? Will you ski in P.E. in winter?
problems.answer: Краткие ответы Yes/No + вопросы Do / Does / Did / Will …?

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 10, с. 8. Дополни сообщение Криса учителю, используя am, is или are.
steps: Dear Mrs Nelson, how are you? I am fine. My family and I are in Russia this year. My dad is a journalist and he has an interesting job here. My school is big. My classmates are friendly. Egor and Sveta are my new friends. The lessons are interesting.
Правило: I — am; he/she/it, ед. ч. — is; we/you/they, мн. ч. — are.
problems.answer: am, are, is, is, are, are, are

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 11, с. 8. Прочитай сообщение Криса ещё раз и ответь на вопросы.
steps: 1) Yes, he does. He likes his Russian school.
2) He is happy because he has made two new friends.
3) On Tuesday Chris had five lessons.
4) During the break they played games and talked.
5) His favourite subject is English.
problems.answer: Ответы по тексту сообщения Криса

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 12, с. 8. Послушай диалог и скажи, какие каникулы Света любит больше всего.
steps: Sveta likes summer holidays best of all, because they are the longest and June, July and August are her favourite months.
problems.answer: Летние каникулы — самые длинные

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 13, с. 8. Прочитай диалог и ответь на вопросы.
steps: 1) Students have four holidays each school year: autumn, winter, spring and summer.
2) Summer is his favourite season.
3) My favourite holidays are summer holidays, because they are long and the weather is warm.
problems.answer: Четыре каникул в году; любимые — летние

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 14, с. 9. Прочитай, сравни и выучи: speak, say, tell.
steps: to speak — говорить (на языке), выступать: Do you speak Spanish? Speak slowly, please.
to say — сказать (что-то): He said «Hello». What did she say?
to tell — рассказать, сказать кому-то: Tell me about your holidays. She told us a story.
После tell всегда стоит, кому говорят; после say — нет.
problems.answer: speak — говорить на языке, say — сказать что, tell — сказать кому

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 15, с. 9. A) Заполни пропуски словами speak, say, tell в правильной форме. B) То же в тексте о Джулии Нельсон.
steps: A) will tell; says; said; speak; tells; speak.

B) Julia Nelson, our English teacher, told us about her visit to Russia. She told us that she liked Moscow very much. «You can ask me any questions», she said. We speak English at her lessons. She says that we speak well.
problems.answer: A: will tell, says, said, speak, tells, speak; B: told, told, said, speak, says, speak

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 16, с. 9. Составь предложения из данных слов.
steps: We usually learn new words at school.
Teachers often discuss different problems after classes.
Girls sometimes draw funny pictures on the board during the break.
Boys always play football after school.
Наречия usually / often / sometimes / always ставятся перед смысловым глаголом.
problems.answer: Порядок слов: подлежащее + наречие частоты + глагол + дополнение + обстоятельство

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 17, с. 9. Послушай, повтори и прочитай слова по звукам.
steps: [ə] — computer, ruler, rubber, answer, teacher.
[e] — pen, pencil, tell, letter, desk.
[uː] — do, two, ruler, school, classroom.
[juː] — new, pupil, music, tube.
problems.answer: Чтение слов по группам звуков [ə], [e], [uː], [juː]

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 18, с. 10. Прочитай диалог и скажи, что Крис и его друзья видят в классе.
steps: There are a lot of plants and photos. There is a new computer with a multimedia projector. There are new blinds on the windows. There are many books on the shelves. There is a big map on the wall.
problems.answer: Растения, фото, новый компьютер с проектором, жалюзи, книги, карта

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 19, с. 10. Посмотри на картинки и сравни классные комнаты (в прошлом году и сейчас).
steps: There were no blinds on the windows last year. Now there are white blinds.
There was an old TV on the table. Now there is a new computer.
There were few plants. Now there are a lot of plants.
There was an old blackboard. Now there is a whiteboard.
There was / were — прошлое; there is / are — настоящее.
problems.answer: There was/were … last year. Now there is/are …

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 20, с. 11. Скажи, что ты / твой одноклассник хотели бы иметь в классе.
steps: I would like to have a big TV in my classroom. I would like to have a multimedia projector to watch films at the lessons. I would like to have more plants and comfortable chairs.
My classmate would like to have a computer for every pupil.
problems.answer: I would like to have … in my classroom

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 21, с. 11. Напиши о своём классе: что там есть сейчас и что бы ты хотел(а) там иметь.
steps: My classroom is big and light. There are green blinds on the windows. There is a computer on the teacher's table. There are a lot of plants and a big map on the wall. But I would like to have a new interactive whiteboard and more comfortable desks.
problems.answer: Описание класса: There is / are … + I would like to have …

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 22, с. 11. Послушай запись и скажи, что Крису понравилось в его первый день в школе.
steps: He liked his teacher very much.
problems.answer: Крису понравился учитель

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 23, с. 11. Ответь на вопросы (при необходимости используй Grammar Reference).
steps: 1) Yes, I do. I enjoyed my first day at school.
2) Yes, they do. Adults remember their first day at school.
3) No, I don't. I usually have a few lessons on the first day.
4) Yes, I did. I got a lot of flowers.
5) I gave the flowers to my teacher.
problems.answer: Ответы о первом дне в школе

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 24, с. 11. Заполни пропуски словами speak, say, tell в правильной форме.
steps: says; told; told; speak; will tell; speak.
problems.answer: says, told, told, speak, will tell, speak

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 25, с. 11. Послушай запись, повтори за диктором и прочитай слова.
steps: [juː] — you, computer, new, news, few.
[iː] — we, please, she, read, meet, speak, teacher.
[ʊ] — good, book, full, put, look.
[e] — very, tell, yes, pen, desk.
problems.answer: Чтение слов по звукам [juː], [iː], [ʊ], [e]

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 26, с. 12. Соотнеси картинки и фразы.
problems.answer: G, F, D, C, H, B, A, E, J, I

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 27, с. 13. Дополни текст о Фреде, вставив глаголы в нужной форме (Past Simple).
steps: Правильные глаголы: clean — cleaned, put on — put on, want — wanted, talk — talked.
Неправильные: get up — got up, have — had, be — was, take — took, go — went, make — made, give — gave, speak — spoke.
Текст: Fred got up early. He cleaned his teeth, had breakfast, put on his uniform and went to school. His father made a video. Fred gave flowers to the teacher.
problems.answer: got up, cleaned, had, put, went, made, was, took, gave, spoke

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 28, с. 13. Ответь на вопросы по тексту о Фреде.
steps: 1) Fred got up early because it was his first day at school.
2) His father made a video of him.
3) In the evening they watched the video and spoke about their first school day.
problems.answer: Встал рано — первый день в школе; папа снимал видео; вечером обсуждали

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 29, с. 13. Опиши свой первый день в школе в этом году и сравни его с первым днём Фреда.
steps: On my first school day I got up at seven. I put on my school uniform and went to school with my mum. I met my friends and my teacher. We had a lesson about our summer holidays. I liked meeting my friends best of all.
Like Fred, I got up early and gave flowers to my teacher. But my father didn't make a video.
problems.answer: Рассказ о своём 1 сентября + сравнение с Фредом

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 30, с. 13. Прочитай и запомни, как строится вежливая просьба с could.
steps: Could you + глагол …? — Не могли бы вы …? Could you close the window? Could you help me, please?
Ответы: Of course. / Sure. / Certainly. / Sorry, I can't.
problems.answer: Could you …, please? — вежливая просьба

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 31, с. 13. Напиши диалоги к трём ситуациям (вежливые просьбы).
steps: 1) — Could you give me a pen and a workbook? — Of course. — Thanks.
2) — Could you help me with the washing up? — Of course. — Thank you very much.
3) — Could you tell me the way to the library? — Sure, it's on the second floor. — Thanks a lot.
problems.answer: Три диалога с Could you …? — Of course / Sure

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 32, с. 13. Напиши о своём первом дне в школе.
steps: On my first day at school I got up early because I was excited. I had breakfast, put on my uniform and went to school with my parents. I gave flowers to my teacher. We had a short lesson and then we went home. My family and I had a party in the evening. It was a wonderful day.
problems.answer: Рассказ 6–8 предложений в Past Simple

chapters.title: 1 Welcome to our school. Section 2. Best Wishes to Russian Students

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 33, с. 14. Послушай запись и скажи, почему Крис счастлив.
steps: Chris is happy because he has got a letter from Mrs Nelson, his English teacher.
problems.answer: Он получил письмо от миссис Нельсон

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 34, с. 14. Прочитай диалог по ролям.
steps: Читаем диалог Криса и друзей о письме миссис Нельсон по ролям.
problems.answer: Чтение диалога по ролям

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 35, с. 14. Соотнеси слова, чтобы получить словосочетания.
problems.answer: c, d, f, e, g, h, a, b

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 36, с. 14. Прочитай и запомни слова из таблицы.
steps: Читаем и запоминаем слова по теме: invitation — приглашение, invite — приглашать, stay — оставаться, гостить, wish — желать, hope — надеяться, programme — программа.
problems.answer: Слова таблицы — прочитать и выучить

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 37, с. 15. Прочитай письмо и скажи, что предложила миссис Нельсон Крису и его друзьям.
steps: Mrs Nelson would like to invite Chris's new Russian friends to London.
problems.answer: Пригласить новых друзей Криса в Лондон

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 38, с. 16. Найди в письме миссис Нельсон (с. 15) слова с данными значениями.
steps: start, hope, stay, show, help, wish.
problems.answer: start, hope, stay, show, help, wish

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 39, с. 16. Прочитай и запомни правило о модальных глаголах can, could, may.
steps: can — умею, могу (просьба среди друзей): Can I take your pen?
could — вежливая просьба: Could you help me?
may — просьба о разрешении (более официально): May I come in?
Ответы: Yes, you may. / Sure. / Of course. / Sorry, you can't.
problems.answer: can — просьба, could — вежливая просьба, may — разрешение

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 40, с. 16. Задай вопросы, используя can, could, may.
steps: May I come in? — Yes, you may.
May I sit down? — Sure.
Can I open the window, please? — Yes, of course.
Could you water the flowers? — Yes, sure.
Could you close the door, please? — Certainly.
problems.answer: May I …? Can I …? Could you …? + ответы

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 41, с. 16. Соотнеси вопросы и ответы.
problems.answer: b, a, c, e, d

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 42, с. 16. Составь свои вопросы по образцу упр. 41.
steps: Can you speak French?
May I go to the party tonight?
Could I borrow your dictionary, please?
Can I take your phone?
Could you write me a letter?
May I use your computer?
problems.answer: Вопросы с can / could / may

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 43, с. 16. Представь, что ты ученик Джулии Нельсон. Ответь на вопросы из её письма (упр. 37) и запиши ответы.
steps: I think it is a great idea. The news is very good.
Yes, I did. I enjoyed my summer holidays very much.
Yes, I do. I like my new subjects.
The new school year started well. My classmates are friendly.
I would like to visit London and see Big Ben.
problems.answer: Ответы на вопросы из письма: идея, каникулы, новые предметы, планы

chapters.title: 1 Welcome to our school. Section 3. My Summer Holidays

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 44, с. 17. Послушай запись и выбери правильный ответ (a или b).
steps: Ученики решили b) написать о некоторых местах в России.
problems.answer: b

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 45, с. 17. Прочитай письмо Егора и поставь глаголы в прошедшее время.
steps: Moscow, Russia, 24 September. Dear Linda, thank you for your message. I spent my summer holidays in the country. The weather was fine. I swam in the river, rode my bike and helped my grandparents. In August we went to the seaside. I had a great time.
Глаголы: spent, was, swam, rode, helped, went, had.
problems.answer: spent, was, swam, rode, helped, went, had

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 46, с. 18. Прочитай текст ещё раз и ответь на вопросы.
steps: 1) He spent his summer holidays in the country.
2) The weather was fine and Egor spent a lot of time outdoors.
3) He swam in the river and rode his bike.
4) He helped his grandparents in the garden.
5) In August he went to the seaside with his parents.
problems.answer: Егор — в деревне: погода хорошая, купался, катался, помогал бабушке с дедушкой, в августе — на море

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 47, с. 18. Заполни пропуски в таблице (существительное / глагол).
steps: visit / to visit — визит / посещать; hope / to hope — надежда / надеяться; wish / to wish — желание / желать; help / to help — помощь / помогать; start / to start — начало / начинать; stay / to stay — пребывание / оставаться; answer / to answer — ответ / отвечать.
problems.answer: visit, hope, wish, help, start, stay, answer — одинаковые формы существительного и глагола

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 48, с. 18. Прочитай и переведи словосочетания, составь с ними предложения.
steps: 1) I spent my summer holidays in the country with my grandparents.
2) I missed my friends very much.
3) We took a lot of photos at the seaside.
4) I went abroad for the first time.
5) We had a wonderful time.
problems.answer: Предложения со словосочетаниями spend holidays, miss friends, take photos, go abroad

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 49, с. 18. Дополни предложения глаголами go, take, miss, spend в нужной форме.
steps: 1) missed; 2) go, spend; 3) spend, misses; 4) took; 5) take; 6) take.
problems.answer: missed; go/spend; spend/misses; took; take; take

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 50, с. 19. Прочитай информацию о знаменитостях и скажи, что ты о них знаешь.
steps: 1) Victor Vasnetsov was a famous Russian artist. There is his museum «Teremok» in Moscow. He painted pictures about Russian fairy tales.
2) Pyotr Tchaikovsky was a great Russian composer. His house-museum is in Klin. He wrote «The Nutcracker» and «Swan Lake».
3) Alexander Pushkin was a great Russian poet. His museum is in Mikhailovskoye.
problems.answer: Васнецов — художник, Чайковский — композитор, Пушкин — поэт

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 51, с. 19. Прочитай и переведи слова (занятие — человек).
steps: art — artist (искусство — художник); music — musician (музыка — музыкант); poetry — poet (поэзия — поэт); science — scientist (наука — учёный); to sing — singer (петь — певец); to write — writer (писать — писатель); to dance — dancer.
problems.answer: artist, musician, poet, scientist, singer, writer, dancer

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 52, с. 20. Посмотри на картинки и скажи, чем знамениты эти люди.
steps: a) Isaac Newton is a famous scientist.
b) William Turner is a famous artist.
c) William Shakespeare is a famous writer and poet.
d) The Beatles are famous musicians.
e) Charles Darwin is a famous scientist.
problems.answer: Newton — scientist, Turner — artist, Shakespeare — writer, the Beatles — musicians

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 53, с. 20. Послушай запись и скажи, что Крис хотел узнать о России.
steps: He wanted to know the meaning of the word «dacha».
problems.answer: Что значит слово «дача»

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 54, с. 20. Прочитай диалог и ответь на вопросы.
steps: 1) Sveta spent her summer holidays in a camp on the Black Sea.
2) Egor spent his holidays at the dacha.
3) A dacha is a small house in the country where people spend summer.
4) Chris liked the idea of a dacha.
problems.answer: Света — в лагере на Чёрном море; Егор — на даче; дача — загородный домик

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 55, с. 21. Прочитай и переведи словосочетания с many / much / a lot of, составь с ними предложения.
steps: many — с исчисляемыми (many books), much — с неисчисляемыми (much time), a lot of — с любыми.
1) There are a lot of students in the classroom today.
2) I have many books in my bag.
3) We don't have much time.
4) There is a lot of snow in winter.
problems.answer: many + исчисляемые, much + неисчисляемые, a lot of — любые

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 56, с. 21. Закончи предложения, выбрав правильные ответы (a–c).
steps: 1 — b (много писем от одноклассников Криса); 2 — c (много времени у бабушки); 3 — a; 4 — b.
problems.answer: b, c, a, b

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 4, упр. 81, с. 26. Прочитай правило о степенях сравнения прилагательных.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 4, упр. 82, с. 26. Найди в письме Тони все прилагательные и запиши их степени сравнения в два столбика.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 5, упр. 114, с. 32. Прочитай правило о разделительных вопросах (tag questions).
steps: Разделительный вопрос = утверждение + короткий «хвостик» для уточнения: You like music, don't you?

Если отрицательное — хвостик утвердительный (…, do you? / is it? / will he?).
Вспомогательный глагол хвостика совпадает с глаголом предложения: is — isn't, can — can't, did — didn't, will — won't.
